title: Sealant Application at Pressurised Fuselage Joints — Standard Practice

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Standard practice for preparing a surface and applying sealant at a pressurised fuselage joint, covering the chromate-free system, its shortened application window and the compatibility rule for a bead applied against existing sealant.

sections.purpose: To give the standard practice for surface preparation and sealant application at pressurised fuselage joints, for both the chromated and the chromate-free systems.
sections.job_setup_note: The work area must be clean, dry and between fifteen and thirty degrees Celsius with relative humidity below seventy per cent. Mixed sealant has a limited pot life and the surface has a limited window after abrasion, so the materials must not be mixed until the surface is ready. Ventilation is required in an enclosed compartment. Two persons are needed when the run is longer than three metres.
sections.procedure: WARNING: PROVIDE FORCED VENTILATION WHEN SEALANT IS APPLIED IN AN ENCLOSED COMPARTMENT. THE SOLVENT VAPOUR IS HARMFUL. Clean the area with the approved solvent and let it dry fully. Abrade the surface with a non-metallic pad until the finish is uniform and matt. Remove the abrasion residue with a clean lint-free wipe. CAUTION: THE CHROMATE-FREE SYSTEM MUST BE APPLIED WITHIN NINETY MINUTES OF ABRASION. THE CHROMATED SYSTEM ALLOWS FOUR HOURS. DO NOT ABRADE MORE SURFACE THAN CAN BE TREATED INSIDE THE WINDOW. Apply the surface treatment evenly and let it stand for the time on the container. Mix the sealant to the ratio on the container and record the mix time. Apply the fillet bead with the applicator, working in one direction, and tool it to the profile in the drawing. Install any fastener that is to be set wet within the sealant working time and wipe the excess before it cures. Fit the washers EN149290-27 and the screws WES848069-85 wet where the drawing calls for it. Secure loose items clear of the wet bead with the cable ties LN455787K4. Let the bead cure for the time in the table before the area is disturbed. Where a chromate-free bead is applied against an existing chromated bead, overlap the two by at least 20 mm; the two systems are compatible in this direction.
sections.close_out: Examine the finished bead for continuity, for entrapped air and for correct profile. Make sure that no sealant has blocked a drain path. Remove all masking, wipes and mixing containers from the compartment and dispose of them under the applicable waste classification, which is different for the two systems. Record the sealant system used, the mix time and the cure completion time.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. The chromate-free system is the only system released for new work from MOD-111303.

safety_precautions: Provide forced ventilation when sealant is applied in an enclosed compartment.
Wear nitrile gloves and eye protection.
Do not abrade more surface than can be treated inside the application window.

tooling.description: Sealant applicator and tooling spatula set
